requirements_summary: Primary workload: IDE copilot + CI agent that can run tests, linters, and stream build logs back to IDE with <50ms completion latency for short completions.
Need function/tool calling for: test execution, lint invocation, running small builds in sandbox, and returning structured build/test status + logs.
Sandboxing: ephemeral containers per session, network egress controls, mount-only read-only access to repos; support for Docker and OCI runtimes.
Model/version pinning: ability to pin dev, staging, prod model versions; deterministic fallback chain when capacity constrained.
Throughput target: 400 concurrent copilot sessions peak, average 120 rps of short-completion streaming tokens.
Cost sensitivity: high for background batch code actions; willing to pay premium for low-latency interactive paths.
Observability: per-route token breakdown, per-request latency histograms, and traceable build-log attachments for debugging.
Data controls: retention policy per team, on-demand audit exports, and KMS-backed key management for stored artifacts.
notes: Customer quote: 'We can't risk a model invoking arbitrary system calls without a hardened sandbox and audit trail.'
SE note: wants an RFC for sandbox lifecycle and ephemeral artifact cleanup window (default 24h, configurable).
Procurement: legal wants a narrow AUP for code execution; finance evaluating estimated ARR band.
POC results: streaming build logs worked well in dedicated cluster; test-run orchestration needs a small wrapper to expose exit codes in JSON for model to parse.
Action items: assemble KMS integration checklist, put together signed SOC2/ISO artifacts pack, create sample function-calling schema for 'run_test' and 'run_linter'.
Risk: secret scanning—customer asked for automatic redaction of token-like strings from logs before they are written to Redwood storage.
